title: Registry token passed as a build argument in dockerfile — review required
description: ARG NPM_TOKEN accepts a registry credential as build input. Build arguments are recorded in image history and are visible to every step, so the token remains recoverable from the built image even after the layer that used it. The rule flags the argument name; whether the value is supplied at build time is a review decision.
remediation: Use a BuildKit secret mount (RUN --mount=type=secret) or a pre-authenticated .npmrc that is removed in the same layer.
limitation: Lexical: matches token-like ARG names; a secret mounted through BuildKit is out of scope and is the recommended form.
